concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-wells-ic-change-your-bank-account]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted Wells IC route for viewing and changing a role-scoped merchant account's disbursement bank account through the Control Panel, with supporting-document conditions and a US-business-checking replacement requirement; not Wells Flat or independent current Wells Fargo policy, and the UI procedure does not establish whether an API route exists or prove an individual payout
warnings: The captured route is Wells IC-specific; do not apply it to Wells Flat or independent current Wells Fargo policy.
The documented Control Panel procedure does not establish API availability or absence.
